description: This file defines and registers Prometheus metrics related to the etcd v2 store, including counters for reads, writes, failures, expirations, and watchers, along with functions to report these metrics.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and registers Prometheus metrics, with handling for duplicate registration during tests.

methods.name: reportReadSuccess
methods.description: Increments the read counter for a successful read action.

methods.name: reportReadFailure
methods.description: Increments the read counters for a failed read action.

methods.name: reportWriteSuccess
methods.description: Increments the write counter for a successful write action.

methods.name: reportWriteFailure
methods.description: Increments the write counters for a failed write action.

methods.name: reportExpiredKey
methods.description: Increments the counter for expired keys.

methods.name: reportWatchRequest
methods.description: Increments the counter for incoming watch requests.

methods.name: reportWatcherAdded
methods.description: Increments the count of active watchers.

methods.name: reportWatcherRemoved
methods.description: Decrements the count of active watchers.
